about: [C12 after the critic] IV's other way by the pad: tools/lib/c5_door.mjs 'good' with the choice 'glass' (shoot the shadows through the frosted door glass before they burst in) on the fake pad, walking to the desk as a stick walks ("strafe": the left stick pushed toward it with the eyes kept on the door - the driver's keyboard walk turned round to face the desk first, a second and more on a stick, and the men in at the door shot him on his way); the aim friction acts only on a man in sight, never on a shadow behind the frosted glass or a man behind a wall (a sampler logs, every 0.25 s while a gun is out, each living man in the friction's ring and whether the eye sees him, and the friction then). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/pad_gunfight_glass.json

steps.label: the first press wakes the pad: the bracket only

steps.eval: (window.__fr = { ringHidden: 0, ringSeen: 0, frHidden: [], frSeen: [] }, setInterval(() => { const W = G.player.weapons && G.player.weapons.active; if (!W || G.state !== 'playing') return; const m = G.camera.matrixWorld.elements, ex = m[12], ey = m[13], ez = m[14], fx = -m[8], fy = -m[9], fz = -m[10]; let seenIn = false, hidIn = false; for (const h of G.stage.hoods.list) { if (!h.alive || !h.bones || !h.bones.chest) continue; const c = h.bones.chest.matrixWorld.elements, dx = c[12] - ex, dy = c[13] - ey, dz = c[14] - ez, L = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz); if (L < 0.5 || L > 45) continue; const ang = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (dx * fx + dy * fy + dz * fz) / L))); if (ang >= 2.2 * Math.atan2(0.3, L)) continue; if (N.pad.sees(ex, ey, ez, c[12], c[13], c[14])) seenIn = true; else hidIn = true; } const f = N.pad.friction(); if (hidIn && !seenIn) { window.__fr.ringHidden++; window.__fr.frHidden.push(+f.toFixed(2)); } if (seenIn) { window.__fr.ringSeen++; if (window.__fr.frSeen.length < 30) window.__fr.frSeen.push(+f.toFixed(2)); } }, 250), 1)

steps.label: good (glass) by the pad, walking to cover as a stick walks (strafe: no turn round): every movement won

steps.eval: ({ ringHidden: window.__fr.ringHidden, hiddenFrictionMax: Math.min(1, ...window.__fr.frHidden.concat([1])), frHiddenAllOne: window.__fr.frHidden.every((f) => f === 1), ringSeen: window.__fr.ringSeen, frSeen: window.__fr.frSeen.slice(0, 12), rumbleN: N.pad.rumbleN })

steps.label: the friction: none on a man out of sight (a shadow behind the frosted glass, a man behind a wall), some on a man in sight
